compatibility_direction: previous producer schema to current reader/producer schema

classifications.additive-compatible: Only optional fields were added; current readers can consume historical artifacts and tolerant historical readers can ignore new fields.
classifications.reader-compatible: The current reader can consume supported historical artifacts without source rewrite, but older readers are not guaranteed to accept every newly produced value.
classifications.breaking: Historical or downstream interpretation is not safely preserved; the transition must fail closed.

historical_read_rules.optional_default_rule: A newly added optional field may be supplied only from a schema-declared deterministic default.
historical_read_rules.required_field_rule: A missing required current field without a declared deterministic default blocks the read.
historical_read_rules.mixed_version_bundle_rule: A bundle containing more than one schema name/version identity is BLOCKED.

human_readable_output.rule: Markdown/text presentation may change independently; only machine-readable artifacts and lineage receipts are schema-gated.
